feature_name: Schema editing for structured data imports in Vertex AI Search data stores
summary: Allows users to review and edit a schema before importing structured data from BigQuery or Cloud Storage into a Vertex AI Search data store.
extended_definition: Allows users to review and edit a schema before importing structured data from BigQuery or Cloud Storage into a Vertex AI Search data store.
